chunks: And it is narrated: "She makes it permissible by striking one of her hands against the other."

key_terms.بِضَرْبِ: by striking; by means of a physical act
key_terms.تَسْتَحِلُّهُ: she renders it permissible or lawful
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; indicates a transmitted report

ai.seo_question: How is permissibility indicated in this hadith from Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This report conveys a legal indication that permissibility is established through a specific physical gesture, namely striking one hand against the other. In its chapter context, it relates to rulings connected to livelihoods, transactions, and lawful permission.
